text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Nghhh... Ugh, this doesn't work either.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I need a reset. Maybe I should post that other one first.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Okay, then listen carefully!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: If I win, you have to be my Droit date!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
All right. But don't lose, 'kay? Otherwise,
I'm going to the dance with
someone else!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right. It's already Droit time. Not that I
really care... Huh? An
email?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Tracen Academy Student Council
President, Symboli Rudolf"? Why
was this
sent to this address? ...Wait, huh?!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"You are requested to perform at the
Ligne Droite"?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tonight at the Ligne Droite

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The Ligne Droite... Commonly known as
the "Droit," this spectacular
dance party
serves to celebrate the start of a new
school year, when
the cherry blossoms are
in full bloom.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
All the young ponies are adorable in how
they get so anxious in
anticipation of this
big day. And while finding the right outfit
to wear
is important, the most crucial thing
is...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Looking for a partner to dance with in the
main event of the night.
Yes! It's finding
the perfect date to celebrate this
incredible moment
in one's life.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Snooore...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, am I boring you? Sorry about that.
Time to wake up, princess.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
What's the big fuss? Messing up my nap on
this beautiful day, talking
about "dro"...
What's it called again?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The Droit, got it? I'm about to make even
more of a fuss, so I thought
it best to give
a little background info first. Now... I have
something
to ask you.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky... would you do me the honor of
being my date?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Uh...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa—what'd you just say?
Your "date"? You mean you
want me to be
your partner for the dance?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Precisely! They're holding an exhibition
dance at the Droit, you see.
In short, it'll
be a big kickoff to the main event.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I know this happens every year, but... the
president is working extra
hard this time. I
wanted to help out, so I proposed the
exhibition idea
to her.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: You don't say...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Not interested in the slightest, are you? Well, everyone is busy with their races. But it'd just be so wonderful if they would all attend...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: So you're goin' around acting as a spokesperson, I get it now. But why would you ask me to be your partner?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to be blunt, but we're not super
close or anything, right? I'm not
in Ritto
Dorm, and I'm not part of a committee
with you or anything.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: However, we are both students at this academy. Isn't that close enough? I suppose it is a bit of a stretch. But aside from that...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You're right. It's customary to ask the
person you have the closest
relationship
with when choosing a date.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The Droit is an important turning point. So
it's natural to spend the
occasion with a
partner who's shared the experiences you
had the
past year.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"If I win, will you be mine?" Seriously,
some people choose their
partner based
on who wins a race.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: That's what I'm saying...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: But this time, I'm going to be in charge of the exhibition dance. So I'm looking to do just one thing—making the Droit the most thrilling it can be.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And if anyone is capable of doing that... it
could only be you, the
"Trickster" herself.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...All right. I mean, I don't get your
reasoning one bit, but I see that
you're
serious about this.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
So I guess I should be up-front with you.
My answer is "NO." I ain't
goin'. Find
somebody else.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I know you're planning something big, but
the spotlight's not for me. I
don't dance in
anything besides winning concerts. Not to
mention...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I just don't have the time right now. I was
actually thinking of taking
my next race
kinda seriously this time.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hm... Understood. Then how about this for
an idea? Let's make a little
deal.

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Follower A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, a jump shot! You see how high it
went? I dunno how you do it,
Sirius!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Sigh... There's no fun, no excitement, no challenge here... I'm done with pool.

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Follower B
text_block_list.text:
Uh, already?! And it's been forever since I
got to spend a day off with
you. Umm,
there must be something you'd find
exciting...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ding!

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Follower B
text_block_list.text:
Oh, perfect timing! Hey, so like, there's
this track producer I'm really
into right
now, and they just posted a new song!
Wanna hear it?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Sure... Might as well.

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Follower B
text_block_list.text:
You'll love it! They're called
"!monad"—real identity's a total mystery.

Every so often they'll drop a remix or new
track on social media, then
go silent again!

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Follower B
text_block_list.text: They're so good! The sound is aggressive and super tight! But it's got that old-school West Coast vibe too! Killer!

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Follower B
text_block_list.text:
O-oh, yikes. Sorry, I got so excited!
Anyway, give it a try! Here's the
account.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
!monad... The profile is just their username,
and the only posts are
songs... Hm? This
icon...

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Follower B
text_block_list.text:
So, actually... Hehe, I dunno if it's really
gonna happen, but this year I
suggested—

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Follower A
text_block_list.text: Ah! Sirius, look!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You're alive and well it seems, Sirius
Symboli.
